one_line: Forward-time test of whether the frozen domoic-acid onset model beats its rolling baseline at prior-clean stations, scored by the lab's existing scorer.
claim_under_test: At a CalHABMAP station with no recent domoic-acid detections (prior-clean), the frozen da_forecast_hgbt model ranks the NEXT roughly-weekly visit's toxic-onset risk better than the pda_roll3_value baseline, using only information available before that visit is sampled.

retrospective_result_being_replicated.note: These are RETROSPECTIVE numbers. The pilot exists to see if they hold forward in time.

prospective_success_gate.primary_metric: d_ap = AP(model) - AP(baseline) over resolved prior-clean onset predictions
prospective_success_gate.constants_note: Mirrors the MBAL evidence gate: power n>=30, PERM_ALPHA 0.05. Do NOT loosen without re-deriving from data.

verdicts.PASS: n>=30 AND d_ap>0 AND d_ap_ci95_lower>0 AND perm_p<=0.05 -> prospectively confirmed; eligible to promote from candidate.
verdicts.FAIL: n>=30 AND (d_ap<=0 OR perm_p>0.05) -> retrospective win did not replicate forward; record as honest null.
verdicts.COLLECTING: n<30 -> underpowered; keep logging, do not read the result yet.
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: n>=30, d_ap>0, perm_p<=0.05, but CI lower touches 0 -> collect more before believing it.

onset_definition.MUST_MATCH: reports/hab/da_forecast.json onset definition. Fill these three from the frozen model's training config. Do NOT invent a threshold — a mismatch here silently changes the labels and invalidates the comparison.

leakage_rules: A prediction is written at decision time, BEFORE the target visit is sampled.
decision_utc must be strictly earlier than the target visit's lab-result timestamp.
predictions.jsonl and outcomes.jsonl are both append-only; nothing is edited in place.
Outcomes join to predictions only by (station_id, target_visit_date).
Scoring calls adapter.score(), which must delegate to the lab's existing AP/bootstrap/permutation scorer. This harness does not re-implement statistics.

runtime_files.note: All runtime files are git-ignored: they hold real station data and must not enter the public repo. Only aggregate summary numbers (no per-station rows) are ever surfaced to the site.
